messages:
Harper Lee: Heads-up  ACME saw a weekend surge and several calls timed out. Can we make a 1-page "Activation Pocket Guide" customers can run through in 10-15 minutes to stabilize things (prefill, batching, streaming)?
Diego Alvarez: Yup. I'll keep it super short: five action bullets, one copy-paste curl, one jitter rule, and three plain metrics to watch.
Anya Morozova: Plain metric names: prefill_success_rate, stream_p95_ms, inflight_requests. Add exact alarm values customers can paste.
Harper Lee: For alarms propose: ALERT if prefill_success_rate < 65% OR stream_p95_ms > 750ms for 6 hours. Also a renewal flag: if either condition lasts 48h escalate.
Diego Alvarez: Copyable curl (one-liner):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"tenant":"acme","items":["welcome","summary"],"parallel":2}'
```
Jitter suggestion: schedule prefill every 6m ± rand(0..40s).
Anya Morozova: Customer-friendly knobs: cache TTLs: ephemeral=5m, session=30m, static=8h. Batch size: 2-5 (start low). Client timeout: 10s then fallback to streaming with max_chunk_tokens=64.
Kai Nguyen: Health colors (copyable): GREEN = prefill_success_rate ≥ 78% AND stream_p95_ms < 450ms; YELLOW = prefill_success_rate 60–78% OR stream_p95_ms 450–750ms; RED = prefill_success_rate < 60% OR stream_p95_ms > 750% OR sustained 5xx.
Harper Lee: Add a short customer email template: Subject: "Activation note: simple steps to improve latency" Body: 3 bullets (what we saw, 3 actions we recommend, link to guide).
Diego Alvarez: Include public escalation path: support@redwood.ai (ask for tenant id + expected peak qps). For urgent help include booking link: https://cal.com/redwood-cs/30.
Anya Morozova: Small feedback widget idea: thumbs up / thumbs down + one-line "result after changes". CS will copy answers into renewal notes.
OpsBot: Draft guide uploaded internally: https://confluence.redwood.ai/cs/activation-pocket-guide-draft (internal). Remember to swap ops email for support@redwood.ai in the public copy.
Harper Lee: Action items: Diego to draft the 1-pager, Anya to paste alarm snippets, Kai to add color table and email template. Target publish to enablement repo by tomorrow AM. Closing thread  will post final link when done. :rocket:
